setup.title: Getting started
setup.subtitle: From an empty plant to the first values read from a PLC, in four steps. You can change everything later.
setup.plant_desc: A plant (site) and the department or line (area) the PLC is in.
setup.org_hint: The organization keeps one customer's or company's data and users apart.
setup.plc_desc: OpenEdge connects to the PLC and reads its variables. Test the connection before going on.
setup.s7_hint: Rack and slot: S7-1200 and S7-1500 are usually 0 and 1; S7-300 and S7-400 usually 0 and 2. PUT/GET access must be enabled on the PLC.
setup.test_fail: The PLC does not answer from the server.
setup.test_fail_hint: Check the address, the network and the firewall. If the PLC can only be reached from an edge box installed on the shop floor, the test from the server fails anyway: go on, and assign the PLC to the box from the Gateways page.
setup.tags_desc: Tags are the PLC variables to read: temperatures, states, counters.
setup.tags_import_desc: Download the template, fill in the signal list and upload it: you see a preview before saving.
setup.tags_manual_desc: One at a time from the Tags page.
setup.tags_browse_desc: Browse the OPC UA server's variables and pick the ones you need.
setup.done_desc: The PLC's values are read and stored. Now you can:
setup.next_trend: See the values in a chart
setup.dash_desc: The plant is still empty. The guided setup takes you to the first values read from a PLC in a few minutes.
